project_name: JARVIS AI OS — Personal Autonomous Command Center
emotional_tone: Cinematic, razor-sharp, ultra-responsive futuristic command center with warm personal companion empathy

entry_surfaces./: cinematic desktop command center: top live telemetry metrics bar, left dynamic 6-module navigation sidebar, center reactive glowing multi-state JARVIS Orb with voice waveform + interactive chat & visual feed, right contextual multi-panel grid for real-time task outputs, flights, terminal, and briefing summaries

visual_enhancers.grid_background: subtle futuristic grid lines via svg overlay with radial fade, 40px grid size, opacity 0.08
visual_enhancers.particle_canvas: lightweight floating cyber particle mesh on center orb zone and background canvas
visual_enhancers.scanlines: subtle 2px linear-gradient scanline overlay on terminal & telemetry monitors
visual_enhancers.glass_blur: backdrop-blur-xl combined with border-cyan-500/20 and soft inner cyan highlight box-shadow
visual_enhancers.audio_reactive_glow: Web Audio API analyser connected to microphone and TTS audio element modulating orb scale (1.0 to 1.35) and box-shadow glow intensity

IDLE.description: Faint pulse (1.8s ease-in-out), slow 360deg ring rotation (12s linear), subtle cyan/navy shifting core, light particle drift

LISTENING.description: Dynamic ripple waves expanding outward synced with microphone volume level, inner concentric rings reacting to voice frequencies

THINKING.description: Accelerated counter-rotations (1.5s), energetic core condensation, pulsing cyan-blue particle flare

SPEAKING.description: Outward pulsating concentric shockwaves synchronized to Edge-TTS / Web Speech output audio amplitude, smoothly returning to IDLE when speech ends

motion.reduced_motion_fallback: All spinning rings and waveform transforms degrade gracefully to opacity fades if prefers-reduced-motion is enabled
motion.hover_lift: transform: translateY(-2px), transition: transform 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease

orb_animations.pulse: keyframes jarvisPulse { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 35px rgba(0,240,255,0.4)); } 50% { transform: scale(1.06); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 65px rgba(0,240,255,0.7)); } }
orb_animations.ring_spin: keyframes spinClockwise { from { transform: rotate(0deg); } to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
orb_animations.ring_counter_spin: keyframes spinCounterClockwise { from { transform: rotate(360deg); } to { transform: rotate(0deg); } }

accessibility.wcag_level: WCAG AA (4.5:1 minimum on all body copy against dark surfaces)
accessibility.aria_roles: All live console updates use aria-live='polite', audio toggle has explicit aria-pressed, voice recording button has aria-label in Turkish
accessibility.data_testid_convention: Strict kebab-case role-based testids on all actionable controls and live metrics (e.g. data-testid='voice-mic-button', data-testid='jarvis-orb-container', data-testid='agent-badge-companion')

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME & ATMOSPHERE: Build a deep dark navy/void black (#060A14) cinematic command center with electric cyan (#00F0FF) and neon blue accents. Use glassmorphism cards with fine glowing borders (border-cyan-500/20) and subtle grid/particle canvas.

2. TURKISH UI LANGUAGE: Ensure 100% of the UI copy, agent responses, prompts, and tooltips are natural, friendly yet senior-engineer grade Turkish (as requested in rule 5: samimi ve dostça dertleşme, üst düzey mühendis ciddiyetinde iş yapma).

3. CENTRAL JARVIS ORB: Build a breathtaking multi-ring SVG / Canvas + Framer Motion interactive Orb with 4 reactive states (IDLE, LISTENING, THINKING, SPEAKING). Integrate Web Speech API (tr-TR) and audio waveform synthesis so the Orb genuinely reacts to voice and speech audio playback.
4. MULTIMODAL & VISION: Support image file upload (screenshot, error logs) with simulated computer vision analysis displaying detected code line, highlighted bug, and direct fix patch.
5. 6 SPECIALIZED AGENTS: Clearly render agent routing badges on all chat stream messages (Companion & Vision, Web & Browser, Media & OS, Dev Core, Research & Study, Executive Briefing).

6. FLIGHT & WEB SCANNER: Render ticket search results as a crisp comparative matrix table showing Airlines (THY, Pegasus, SunExpress), Departure/Arrival times, durations, prices in TRY/EUR, and instant book/save actions.
7. MEDIA & SYSTEM CONTROLLER: Embed a functional YouTube music player interface with live play/pause, volume slider, track title, and background audio simulation.
8. TERMINAL & CONSOLE: Build a sandboxed interactive terminal executing real shell commands or simulated safe developer scripts with clear destructive-action confirmation dialogs.
9. BRIEFING & DAILY REPORT: Provide an automated end-of-day summary generator ('Gün Sonu Raporu Çıkar') synthesizing completed tasks, commits, notes, and music played.
10. TESTING COMPLIANCE: Place data-testid attributes on every button, input, toggle, metric tile, and modal dialog.
